read.thesis: Teva Q3 2024 revenue $4.3B up 15% LC with non-GAAP margin 53.7% and FY24 revenue guide raised to $16.1–16.5B, but US generic pricing is structurally falling and no capacity discipline was discussed.

triggers.label: US generic prices pushed down
triggers.quote: Our general point of view on this is prices will be pushed down.

triggers.label: FY24 revenue guide raised $100M
triggers.quote: we're raising our 2024 full-year revenue guidance to $16.1 billion to $16.5 billion.

triggers.label: UZEDY FY24 revenue $80M → $100M
triggers.quote: we are now expecting UZEDY revenue for the full year to be at $100 million, compared to our prior expectation of $80 million
triggers.highlight: $100 million, compared to our prior expectation of $80 million

guidance.quote: we're raising our 2024 full-year revenue guidance to $16.1 billion to $16.5 billion.
our earnings per share guidance range by $0.10 to be between $2.40 and $2.50.
free cashflows are expected to be between $1.7 billion to $2 billion for the full year.
we are now expecting UZEDY revenue for the full year to be at $100 million
We continue to expect our non-GAAP gross margin to be between 53% to 54% for the full year
operating expenses to be in the 27% to 27.5% range for the full year
operating income margin of 30%, net debt adjusted EBITDA of two times and cash to earnings of 80%
we should be in a position to complete that divestment in H1 of 2025

red_flags.label: GAAP net loss $437M on impairment and legal
red_flags.quote: GAAP net loss in Q3 2024 was $437 million

red_flags.label: EU Copaxone fine $350M provision, multi-year appeal
red_flags.quote: that will take many, many years, unfortunately

evasions.quote: obviously we'll give guidance on that at the start of the year
I don't think we ever think that's there's one extreme or the other.
